{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", trial_df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id']).sum())

# Check the value counts for 'site'
print("Site value counts:\n", trial_df['site'].value_counts())

# Check the value counts for 'arm'
print("Arm value counts:\n", trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the value counts for 'severity'
print("Severity value counts:\n", trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check the response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by site:\n", response_rate_by_site)"}
